# Vice Capital

> Independent GTA VI (Grand Theft Auto 6) intelligence: the TTWO stock angle, the in-game
> economy, and the content economy around the November 19, 2026 launch. Unofficial fan
> project; not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Not financial advice.

## Guides
- [GTA 6 Release Date, Editions & Pre-Orders (2026)](https://gta6.wxza.net/guides/gta-6-release-date/): GTA 6 releases November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99. Pre-load opened Nov 10; GTA 6 launched November 19, 2026 and is live now. No PC version at launch — here are the full details.
- [How to Invest in GTA 6: TTWO Stock, Targets & Catalysts (2026)](https://gta6.wxza.net/guides/how-to-invest-in-gta-6-ttwo-stock/): There is no "GTA 6 stock" — the pure-play is Take-Two Interactive (TTWO). Analyst targets (consensus mean ~$290, range $262–$330, as of Nov 19, 2026), the launch catalyst record, peripheral plays, and the risks.
- [How to Make Money in GTA 6 Online: The Capitalist Playbook](https://gta6.wxza.net/guides/how-to-make-money-gta-6-online/): The ToS-safe way to build wealth in GTA 6 Online: own income assets early, price your time, and move first. No glitches, no modded accounts, no bans.
- [The GTA 6 Map: All Six Regions of Leonida Explained](https://gta6.wxza.net/guides/gta-6-map-regions-leonida/): GTA 6 is set in Leonida, a Florida-inspired state nearly twice the size of GTA V. Here are all six regions — Vice City, the Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga.
- [GTA 6 Trailers: An Extended Look & the Launch Trailer](https://gta6.wxza.net/guides/gta-6-trailer-3/): There was no GTA 6 Trailer 3 — Rockstar never released a video by that name. The final pre-launch drops were An Extended Look (August 27, 2026) and the official Launch Trailer (October 15, 2026). What they showed, and how trailer days move TTWO.
- [Is GTA 6 Coming to PC? Expected Release Window & What We Know](https://gta6.wxza.net/guides/gta-6-pc-release/): GTA 6 launches console-only on November 19, 2026. No PC date is announced — Rockstar’s history points to late 2027–2028. The pattern, the why, and how to prepare.
